name: wordpress-server-ops
responsibility: Package reusable server-phase guidance for safe Cursor Remote-SSH work in WESEO WordPress and WST project roots.
assumptions: The plugin is used from a Cursor workspace connected to a WordPress root or equivalent server-side project checkout.
Project-specific URLs, server hostnames, WordPress roots, WP-CLI commands, cache commands, editable path exceptions, upload policies, and access setup live in the project-local template.
Server-side WordPress, PHP, ACF, WST, WP-CLI, content, and media work can hand off to local frontend implementation through the Section handoff contract.

rules.name: server-phase-boundary
rules.description: Define which work remains in the server phase and which work hands off to local frontend implementation.

rules.name: webroot-safety
rules.description: Prevent scratch, export, and temporary artifacts from being created inside a public WordPress root.

rules.name: file-edit-boundary
rules.description: Keep file edits inside project-approved WordPress paths and use project context for exceptions.

rules.name: wp-cli-cache
rules.description: Document WP-CLI and cache expectations using project-local command placeholders.

rules.name: wordpress-content-editing
rules.description: Guide safe WordPress REST and ACF Flexible Content updates without project-specific layout lists.

skills.name: setup-orientation
skills.description: Perform complete first setup for a WESEO WordPress/WST Remote-SSH workspace: root detection, Project Context creation, local Git access, WP-CLI/cache verification, Cursor guidance, safe temp policy, and local-only MCP configuration.

skills.name: wp-media-import
skills.description: Import media through WP-CLI with reusable filename, metadata, verification, cache, and cleanup steps.
